apps.name: YTKACE
apps.subtitle: Open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader
apps.localizedDescription: YTKACE is a free, open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS with SponsorBlock, background playback, player controls, and interface customization.
apps.versionDescription:
by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.40.5
• Redesigned the download tab to look more like YouTube, with an All tab and your active downloads shown at the top
• Smaller download popup that you can swipe away, and failed downloads stay so you can retry them
• Playlist downloads now get the whole playlist, including private playlists and Liked videos
• Liquid Glass tab bar is see-through while scrolling Shorts
• Added Frosted Tab Bar option (Default, On, Off)
• Added Normal Home Layout for the Home redesign some accounts get
• Added Remove Horizontal Shelves
• Added Hold to Copy Text for community posts and comments
• Added Play Shorts Once
• Added Two-Finger Tap to Pause
• Added Extra Dim
• Added Share at Current Time
• Added Lock Screen Skip
• Added Remove Suggestion Pill for Shorts
• SponsorBlock skip popup now fades in and out

Fixed:
• Shorts download button, Fullscreen and pinch to fullscreen on the new Shorts UI
• Captions On picking the wrong language
• App opening in Shorts when a different start tab is set
• White or black bar behind the Liquid Glass tab bar
• Share sheet position on iPad

YouTube 21.40.5 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.1.2_YouTube_21.40.5.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.1.2_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16
